# Couple in Bed Beneath Floating Hearts — reference review

- source: `pictographic-primitives/_uncategorized_26/love boat_74aefd26-5ecb-469f-857a-7b635d067fa7.svg`
- source UUID: `74aefd26-5ecb-469f-857a-7b635d067fa7`
- classification: side_combination
- review: pending_human_review

The bed and two people form a coherent scene independently. Two detached hearts float overhead without strings or physical contact, functioning as affection modifiers.

## Visual draft

Two round heads appear above a bed, with a curved blanket covering the right portion. Two detached hearts float above the figures, while straight bedposts frame the long mattress below.

## 1. Couple in bed (solo)

Two round heads rise above a long bed with straight end posts and a curved blanket covering its right side. Exclude the floating hearts.

## 2. Pair of floating hearts (sub)

Two separate hearts sit diagonally apart, the left higher and upright and the right tilted. Exclude the bed and people.
